evidence.observation: Reboiler temperature rising slowly and smoothly, 405->413 °C
Column profile stable, top ~43-44 °C, no flooding or collapse
Reflux and distillate flows noisy; FT704 briefly dropped to 0.004 L/h at k=16 then recovered, FYI702 ratio stays ~3.6-4.9 and does not track measured flows
Differential pressure fluctuating 0.7-4.0 mbar, consistent with intermittent flow

args.missing_evidence: Distillate/bottoms composition (GC) measurement; confirmation whether FYI702 is computed from FT703/FT704 or independently set, and whether the FT704 dropout was a real flow interruption or sensor glitch
